messages:
oliver: Kicking off the Kuiper region (kuiper-1) project origination — need cloud account + VNet scaffold. Quick runbook below, calling for quotas + tagging + handoff. @sana @raj please ack and chime on gaps.

sana: ack. do we have confirmed GPU quota numbers for kuiper?

raj: not yet — cloud console shows 0 GPUs by default. I can raise quota request as soon as we lock SKU and zone list. which SKUs are we aiming for? A100 vs H100?

oliver: Start with A10G + A100 mix for baseline. target initially: 8 A100s and 16 A10G across two AZs. we can scale later. put quota request for any vCPU and GPU quotas needed.

kevin: draft of the minimal account/project checklist I used last time:
- Create project: owner=eng-infra-kuiper-1, billing=X-Cloud-BU
- Enable APIs: compute, iam, serviceusage, monitoring, logging
- Create service account: infra-robot-kuiper (roles: Owner temporarily, then narrow)
- Tagging policy: redwood:env=prod, redwood:region=kuiper-1, cost-center=infra
- VNet CIDR plan: 10.160.0.0/16 primary; subnets per AZ /20 (10.160.0.0/20, 10.160.16.0/20)

maria: for networking allowlist notes:
- Private control plane endpoints only (no public LB for k8s API)
- NAT per private subnet + centralized NAT gateway
- Svc endpoints for storage and container registry

infra-bot: quota-request-created: #12345 by raj for GPUs (pending approval) :hourglass: 

raj: filed quota request #12345 for 8 A100 + 16 A10G in kuiper zones kuiper-1a, kuiper-1b. ETA 48-72h. added note: support contact infra@cloud-vendor.com.

oliver: Terraform workspace: infra/kuiper-1. Use state bucket redwood-infra-state, prefix kuiper-1. Please follow the network module (version v2.4.0) and enable flow logs. Minimal example: 
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/terraform-modules.git//network"
  name   = "kuiper-1"
  cidr   = "10.160.0.0/16"
  azs    = ["kuiper-1a","kuiper-1b"]
}
```

kevin: remember the NAT sizing — for initial burst we provisioned m/2 NATs behind autoscaling policy. test with socat traffic sim before cluster bring-up.

maria: security group / firewall rules:
- Allow inter-subnet k8s control plane -> nodes on 6443, 10250
- Allow SSH from jumpbox only (ops IPs)
- Block egress to crypto miners (denylist maintained in global-fw policy)

oliver: bootstrap steps (concise):
1) Create project, billing, SA, enable APIs.
2) Apply network TF in workspace infra/kuiper-1 (vpc + subnets + route tables + NGW).
3) Provision bastion + jumpbox in mgmt subnet (restrict keys).
4) Kick off quota approval followups.
5) Terraform outputs: vpc_id, subnet_ids, nat_ips -> share in thread.
6) Run connectivity smoke: from jumpbox run curl to metadata, curl to private bucket endpoint.

raj: config validation hooks I run after TF:
- ipcalc to ensure no overlap with partner regions
- verify flow logs enabled (Cloud Console or APIs)
- check route tables for private workaround routes

kevin: cluster bring-up notes (k8s + GPU infra):
- use kubeadm/eksctl? For Kuiper we're using managed k8s (vendor-k8s-1.27) with private endpoint.
- install nvidia-device-plugin + GPU operator via helm chart version 1.13.0
- ensure node image has CUDA driver support; run `nvidia-smi` check from node shell.

maria: health checks after node pool create:
- `kubectl get nodes -o wide` (ready, gpu allocable resources)
- `kubectl describe node <node>` check labels: redwood/gpu=true, redwood/zone=kuiper-1a/b
- run sample job: `kubectl run cuda-test --image=nvidia/cuda:11.8-base --restart=Never --command -- /bin/bash -c "nvidia-smi && sleep 2"`

oliver: cost & footprint quick calc: initial baseline ~ 8x A100 reserved spot vs on-demand delta. run cost-sim with our estimator and post here before handoff. Also enable billing export to BigQuery (dataset infra_billing_kuiper).

raj: handoff checklist to Platform Eng: 
- TF state in place + outputs produced
- Quotas approved and confirmed
- Jumpbox + key handoff in 1Password (ops/kuiper folder)
- Cluster bootstrap runbook link + helm values (stored in repo infra/kuiper-1/helm)
- Monitoring dashboards: GPU utilization, pod evictions, node thermal metrics

oliver: sign-off process: once infra team confirms the above, we tag the thread with :white_check_mark: and assign to Platform for cluster bootstrap window. propose handoff meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sana: scheduled on my calendar. I'll bring quota approval notes and cost estimate.

kevin: I'll post the TF plan output to this thread after apply in staging workspace. will run smoke suite.

maria: small gotcha from previous region — GCP private DNS needed conditional forwarding for internal registries, add to runbook.

infra-bot: deploy-note: TF apply (staging) succeeded at 2187654389 by kevin — outputs: vpc_id=vpc-0abc123, subnets=[subnet-0a,subnet-0b], nat_ips=[34.56.78.90] :rocket:

oliver: updated. kevin please paste the `terraform output` blob and I'll mark the outputs in the runbook. then Platform can run cluster create.

kevin: pasted outputs and small plan snippet. attaching a short local smoke log: 
```
$ ssh jumpbox@34.56.78.90
$ curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/metadata | head
{...}
$ curl -sS https://storage.kuiper.internal/health || echo ok
ok
```

raj: quota approved email landed. Cloud support ticket: #SUP-4456. GPUs are allocatable now.

oliver: great work team. handoff meeting invite sent. after Platform completes bootstrap we'll run the perf-suite and cost report. :handshake:

sana: thanks everyone. leaving a pinned note in the repo with the checklist.

maria: tagging ops-runbook: /infra/runbooks/kuiper-1-network.md for future updates.

oliver: thread closed after handoff meeting — please open a new thread for post-deploy issues.
